Ariana (Partnerships): heads-up — Catalyst Systems signed LOI. kickoff next Tue. Need a concise onboarding plan: training slots, cert pathway, hw sandbox access, marketplace listing checklist. who can own what?
Lee (SI Enablement): I can lead training. propose: 1) 60m intro + 2) 2x 90m hands-on labs (hosting + private deploy), 3) cert quiz + lab sign-off.
Devon (Sales Eng): +1. for labs we should include a quick demo prompt set and perf targets (latency/cost) so SI knows expectations. I can draft prompts.
Sam (Hardware Partnerships): need to confirm Catalyst's target GPU profile. If they're on A100s vs H100s we need different image/quant configs. I'll ping hw team and share access tokens for sandbox.
Ariana (Partnerships): great. timeline?
Lee (SI Enablement): target training Mon/Tue next week. cert quiz published by EOD Fri. labs booked via our lab calendar — need devicelist by tomorrow for perms.
Devon (Sales Eng): I'll post the prompt set + perf baseline doc by EOD today. link to template: https://redwood.internal/docs/si/lab-prompt-template.md
Sam (Hardware Partnerships): onboard-bot just created a sandbox env: env-id=cat-sb-004. I'll DM creds to Catalyst once we confirm list.
onboard-bot: Checklist created: [training-slots, lab-env, cert-quiz, marketplace-intake, hw-entitlement]. View: https://redwood.internal/onboard/checklists/cat-1755554321
Ariana (Partnerships): @Lee take training lead. @Sam own sandbox access. @Devon draft prompts and perf targets. I'll handle marketplace intake and announcements. Can we sync tomorrow 9:30 PT for 15m to lock times?
Lee (SI Enablement): 9:30 PT works for me. I'll prepare slide deck + quick eval rubric.
Sam (Hardware Partnerships): works. I'll have device list by then.
Devon (Sales Eng): 9:30 PT good. I'll bring the demo prompts.
Ariana (Partnerships): awesome — thanks team. action items captured. :white_check_mark:
Devon (Sales Eng): one more thing — recommend we include a short section on fallback policies (model variants + routing) in the lab. SI often trips over capacity fallbacks.
Lee (SI Enablement): good call — adding a 10m segment on routing/fallback and a small exercise.
Ariana (Partnerships): perfect. closing thread — see you all 9:30 PT tomorrow. :rocket:
